title: Pyari Behna
desc: Kaali blames engineer Vinay for losing his arm in an accident and opposes his love for Seeta. As tensions rise, Vinay must face Kaali's anger to win her hand.

title: Prem
desc: Sanjay is haunted by visions of his past life as Shantanu. His world shifts when he meets Sonia, who resembles a woman from his visions, drawing him into a mysterious fate.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Agent Vinod
desc: Agent Vinod uncovers a chilling truth: his colleague's death was orchestrated by a powerful business elite. As tensions rise, he must navigate danger to seek justice and uncover the conspiracy.

title: Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster 3
desc: After returning from jail, Aditya seeks to reclaim his political legacy, but his encounter with London based gangster Uday sparks a fierce battle for power and survival.

title: The Bhootnii
desc: Heartbroken Shantanu seeks true love under the Virgin Tree, but things spiral when Mohabbat, a lovestruck ghost, begins obsessing over him and turns his life upside down.

title: Goodbye
desc: A family unravels after the sudden death of the mother. As the children rush home for her final rites, clashing opinions ignite tensions, exposing deep-rooted conflicts.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Jism
desc: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls for Sonia, wife of a wealthy traveler. She lures him into murdering her husband, but her shocking motive leaves Kabir stunned.

title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams shatter when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Suhaag
desc: Ajay and Raj, notorious college pranksters, constantly land in trouble. When Ajay applies for a passport, he uncovers a shocking secret about his real identity, changing his life.

title: Pukar
desc: In pre-independence Goa, revolutionaries battle Portuguese rule, but a freedom fighter's son misunderstands a key event and grows up resentful, opposing their cause.

title: Gully Boy
desc: Murad, an underdog from Dharavi, struggles to express his reality and social issues through rap, until meeting local rapper MC Sher, whose guidance transforms his confidence and dreams.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

title: Pitaah
desc: Rudra, a poor labourer in a village ruled by the ruthless Thakur Avadh Narayan Singh, seeks justice after the Thakur's sons rape his minor daughter-vowing to hold them accountable.

title: Muqabala (1979)
desc: Two feared gangsters declare a truce and strike up an unlikely friendship, but their hard-won peace shatters when both fall for the same woman and refuse to let love go.
